About the founder

Run by a GTM engineer, not an account manager.

Hi, I'm Nishkarsh Agarwal, Nish to most people. I started Sparq Labs after three years of building outbound systems: Clay workflows, enrichment automation and sending infrastructure for B2B teams.

Before Sparq I built outbound with Vertical GTM, C17 Lab and OpenBorder. I placed in the top 8 globally at Clay Cup 2026, and I run GTME Launchpad, a community and meetup series for GTM engineers in Bengaluru.

I'm still in every client's Monday review. You work with a small senior team: one GTM engineer who owns your account end to end and never runs more than six, a reply desk on shift from 09:00 to 01:00 IST, and me on the numbers every week.

Questions

What people ask on the first call.

Anything else, ask Nish directly. He reads every email.

Everything from ICP mapping to the booked call: signal research, list building and verification, domain and inbox infrastructure, copy, sending, deliverability monitoring, reply handling, calendar booking, CRM sync, email nurture, database reactivation, signal scoring, custom workflows, a Monday scorecard and a Friday health score. You bring the offer and take the calls.

Campaign launch in three days once ICP, offer and access are approved. We set up the workflow, prepare the first signal-matched list and copy, then launch. Ongoing warm-up and deliverability checks continue after launch.

We commit to a three-day campaign launch after kickoff inputs and approvals are in place. We do not guarantee meetings or revenue; targets are agreed in writing and reported against every week.

Engagements are typically a fit for teams budgeting around $4,000–$5,000 per month, depending on scope and channels, on a three-month initial term. Infrastructure, meaning domains, inboxes and data, is billed at cost and itemised on every invoice. You get the exact number on the strategy call, once we know your volume and markets.

Our reply desk. Every reply is classified and timestamped. Positives get a first response within two minutes around the clock, and a person is on the thread within fifteen minutes on shift, 09:00 to 01:00 IST. Calls are booked straight onto your calendar and synced to your CRM. Not-now replies are nurtured, not dropped.

Yes, as an add-on where your buyers actually spend time there. Tier-one accounts get a connection and a message on day one or two, synced with the email cadence so nobody is hit twice. Human-paced and safe for your account.

Outbound runs on separate lookalike domains, not your main one. Each is authenticated with SPF, DKIM and DMARC and warmed before use. Inboxes are seed-tested twice a week, and a domain that drops below 85% inbox placement is pulled, rested and replaced from the reserve. Daily gates hold bounces under 1.5% and complaints under 0.05%.

One kickoff call, approval of the first list and copy, a calendar to book into, and feedback on which calls were good. That last one is what tightens the next list.
